Name: Pokefy Cries
Author: netherphnx
Description:
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Drop into your SDV mod folder.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Pokefy Cries is the audio companion that reads Pokefy's config so each animal's cry matches its visual. Without Pokefy installed and loaded, Pokefy Cries has nothing to attach its cries to.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy[/url][/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Pokefy Cries
Manifest.Description: Replaces farm animal and pet (cat/dog) sounds with the cries of their Pokefy-equivalent Pokemon. Reads Pokefy's config so the cry always matches the visual.
Manifest.Author: Netherphoenix
